summary: E2E test of CRM Portal-Invite chip & Resend button in CompanyDetail header + backend endpoint verification. All acceptance criteria pass: INVITEDEMO shows 'Portal: Pending set-up' chip + 'Resend invite' button that triggers a success toast ('Portal invite re-sent to invite.demo@pulsedemo.test'); AlphaCo (iso-cA) shows 'Portal: Active' chip and the Resend button is HIDDEN as required; all existing tabs/KPIs render normally with the chip in place. Backend GET/POST portal-invite endpoints return correct payloads. Owner/manager 403 gating COULD NOT be directly verified because the only seeded non-owner CRM account (manager@isodemo.com) is site-restricted to Site A and cannot see INVITEDEMO — the endpoint returned 404 (org/site scope) before the role check fires. Code inspection of crm_v2.py confirms role gate is present (raises 403 for roles other than owner/manager unless is_org_owner/is_master_admin).
action_items: OPTIONAL: seed a non-owner/non-manager CRM user in iso-demo-org (e.g. role='member' or 'sales_rep' visible to INVITEDEMO) to allow direct assertion of the 403 gate; today's manager account is site-scoped away from INVITEDEMO and returns 404 first.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_v2.py resend endpoint gate treats 'manager' as allowed — matches user choice (owners/managers only). Good.
CompanyDetail header renders chip only when showInvite && invite && INVITE_STYLES[status] — falsy states cleanly hide; Resend button also gated by invite.status !== 'active'. Matches requirement 2a.
portal-invite-chip has helpful title showing the contact email — nice UX touch.

success_rate.backend: 100% (endpoints hit: portal-invite GET x2, resend POST x1)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (chip + button visibility + toast + active-state hide + regression tabs all pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded INVITEDEMO (Portal Invite Demo Co, iso-demo-org) and iso-cA (AlphaCo Site A).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM login is embedded in the /crm page (same-looking Pulse login card, but posts to /api/crm/auth/login and returns a CRM-scoped token). After login you land on the CRM Command Center — click the 'Companies' TAB (do NOT navigate to /crm/companies, that returns 404). Company detail chip has data-testid='portal-invite-chip', button data-testid='portal-invite-resend-btn'. Resend fires REAL Resend email to the customer contact — expected behaviour.
